clips.title: The story
paras: William Pestle sends a parcel from Goldshire to his brother Morgan in Stormwind. Its candles carry wax supplies from Elwynn Forest to Pestle's Apothecary in the Trade District.

William gathers herbs, reagents, and raw goods in Goldshire, while his brother Morgan runs Pestle's Apothecary in Stormwind's Trade District. William cannot easily leave his post at the Lion's Pride Inn, so he depends on travelers heading into the city to carry goods for him.

William's parcel holds large candles gathered from kobolds in Elwynn's mines. He says he collects them for their wax. Delivering the shipment brings those supplies to Morgan at Pestle's Apothecary in the Trade District.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles. I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.
I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Oh, a shipment from my brother? Splendid! Fortune truly shines on me today!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here is your payment... And while you're here, take a look around! I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
